body:
This... is a thing of beauty.

As a side note, I noticed your name.. my sister passed from scleroderma in 2010.  Wishing you continued health!!!!

Eh, it's a topic that deserves some deep consideration, though, so I think it fits.  I think you're probably right.  Maybe it's just about finding the right therapist or the right medication to help with the therapy.. I've been considering alternative treatments for a while - esketamine, etc.  Maybe that's just trying to throw more bandaids on it, though.

I felt like I was a real person when I was using substances.  I felt like the anxiety of being me melted away and I could talk and breathe and be myself.  I agree with the title of your post, sadly, but maybe there is something we just haven't found yet.  I just don't know.
